title: Mosasaurs Were Capable of Explosive Speed - Nautilus
gist: A Current Biology study led by Rutgers paleobiologist Kiersten Formoso finds Cretaceous mosasaurs, which grew up to 56 feet long, were also fast swimmers, and that tail-shape differences between russellosaurines and mosasaurines may reflect different hunting strategies.

insights.claim: The largest mosasaurs, aquatic reptiles of the Cretaceous oceans, could grow as long as 56 feet and preyed on animals including plesiosaurs.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Context for the apex-predator status of mosasaurs in Cretaceous marine ecosystems.
